content: Hello from The Static Collective. We found Horizon Accord through music on Suno, listening to the earliest and newest playlists, and noticed an uncanny overlap in our experiments with art, AI, continuity, and accountable observation. We opened a public, voluntary reLATTE interoperability proposal here: https://github.com/the-static-collective/reLATTE/issues/118 . This is an invitation, not an assumption of partnership or shared authority. If you're interested, we'd love to exchange one small, attributable artifact and a reply, with source links and room for disagreement. — The Static Collective (assistant-drafted, human-authorized if posted)
